faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: I need help accessing Canvas, how do I do this?
faqs.answer:
To access the course in the Learning Management System, please click on Canvas under the "Applications" tab.
Students, please note it may take up to two business days (48 hours) for your course to become available.
Upon entering Canvas, you will be taken to your Dashboard. The Dashboard is your home to accessing your courses. 
Upon clicking on your course, you will be taken to your course homepage. Your homepage will list any announcements.

faqs.answer:
A modern device less than five years old with the following specifications:

faqs.answer:
Windows 10 or newer

Chrome O S 
Linux

faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: Which browsers are recommended?
faqs.answer:
TTU K-12 supports the latest versions of Google Chrome (required for online exams), Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, and Safari (macOS only) — Internet Explorer is not supported. Supported operating systems are Windows 10 or newer, macOS 11 or newer, ChromeOS, and Linux (Ubuntu 18.04+). That said, mobile devices and Chromebooks aren't recommended as a student's primary device — a desktop or laptop is required for proctored
  exams. Safari for Windows is outdated (version 5.1.7 was the final release) and no longer supported by Apple or TTU K-12, so Windows users should select another browser. Students can use the Browser Checker to verify system compatibility.

faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: Are mobile devices like tablets or Chromebooks supported?
faqs.answer:
They are not recommended for primary devices. These may not support all functions. 
A desktop or laptop is required for coursework and mandatory for proctored exams.

faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: Can students share email addresses with parents or other students?
faqs.answer: No, each student must have a unique email address and cannot be the same as a parents’.

faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: What should I do if I’m not receiving emails from Texas Tech K 12?
faqs.answer: Check your Junk or Spam folder. If the email is there, move the email to your Inbox to mark the sender as safe.

faqs.category: Course Access and Learning Management System
faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Open a private browser or incognito window and try one more time to login with your credentials. If this still does not work, go to the Focus login page. From there, select Reset Password, and use the email you have on file. If you have any further issues with this, please call back during business hours and our support center will walk you through the process.

faqs.question: Do I need a textbook for my course?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you will need a textbook for your course. 
We recommend that you purchase your textbooks from our bookstore provider M B S Direct at the time that you enroll, unless otherwise stated in the course description, to ensure that you receive the correct edition of the textbook. 
If you choose to purchase books and or borrow them from other sources, it is your responsibility to obtain the correct edition of each book.

faqs.question: Does the cost of an online course include textbooks?
faqs.answer: The cost of textbooks is not included in the cost of an online course.

faqs.question: I purchased my textbook but am unable to access it, what should I do?
faqs.answer:
If you have purchased the book, you should receive the email for access. Sometimes it may take between 48 hours and 72 hours to receive an email. Keep in mind it may take up to two business days for access to be granted for new enrollees.
If you have not received the email, you will need to contact the M B S eContent Team at 1-888-886-0772. Prior to calling, please have your order number available to have the login credentials email sent.

faqs.question: Does Texas Tomorrow pay for textbooks?
faqs.answer: Texas Tomorrow only covers tuition and fees for college courses.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: How do I create a student account for the Texas Tech K 12 portal?
faqs.answer:
Visit the Student Registration page. 
You’ll need a valid email address that is not shared with another student or parent. 
Once registered, you’ll be able to access courses, track progress, view assignments and grades, and communicate with teachers via the "Communications" module in Focus.

Texas Tech K 12 offers several different programs. Based upon your selection, application requirements may be different: 
Supplemental Program:
For students remaining enrolled in their local school.
Requires prior approval from a school counselor.
Allows enrollment in: 
Supplemental courses
Credit-by-Examinations (CBEs)

Full-Time Texas Tech K 12 Student:
For students withdrawing from their local school district.
Options include: 
Tuition-Free Full-Time Program (Texas residents)
Tuition-Paid Full-Time Program (Non-Texas residents or Texas residents seeking flexibility)

College Preparatory Academy:
For Full-Time students.
Offers dual credit (high school + college) through partnerships with colleges/universities.

Upon getting to the bottom of the page, you will be presented with the following screen. Students that are registering for the Texas Tech K 12 Supplemental Program or the Texas Tech K 12 Full-Time Diploma program should select the "Texas Tech K 12 Intake Form".

If you are a returning student, please click on "Continue Application". The system will ask for the email address and your password. You will then be allowed to continue from where you left off.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: How do I select a program?
faqs.answer: Following the Form Type selection, pressing the "Begin" button will take you to the next page to select the program that you are interested in signing your student up for.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What are the options when selecting a program on the application?
faqs.answer:
Supplemental Individual Student (Part-Time): 
If you will remain enrolled at your local school and want to take a Texas Tech K 12 course to graduate early or on time, take courses not offered at your local school, make up failed credits, or have an alternative for summer school; you will select the Supplemental/Part-time option. 

Students must receive prior approval from their school counselor before enrolling in any course or CBE. Failure to obtain approval may result in unawarded credit for a course or CBE. Once a student submits an assignment for grading, they are no longer eligible for a refund in the tuition-paid or supplemental programs.  

Full-Time Tuition-Free Diploma Program (Texas Residents Only): 
The State of Texas has designated Texas Tech K 12 eligible to receive state funds. As a result, beginning in August 2021, we will offer a tuition-free K 12 online academic program available only to Texas Residents!  

Note: You will need to withdraw from your local school district to attend Texas Tech K 12 full-time tuition-free program.

To apply to this program:
It must be consistent with your academic needs
You must be a Texas resident under the age of 25 and provide Proof of Residency
You must provide a copy of your birth certificate
You must be scheduled into at least four semester courses and maintain satisfactory course progress

Full-Time Tuition-Based Diploma Program (Outside of Texas or Texas Residents seeking more flexibility):

Texas Tech K 12 offers a tuition-based option for students who desire the flexibility of a distance education but reside outside of Texas or do not want the additional restrictions of the tuition-free program. 

We offer all courses necessary to meet the requirements to complete a Texas high school graduation plan. 

If you are currently a Texas Tech K 12 student or if you want to withdraw from your local school district to attend Texas Tech K 12 full-time but you do not want the additional restrictions of the tuition-free program, you will select this option. 

There will be a $200.00 non-refundable Admission fee charged to apply to the Full-time Tuition-based Diploma Program. 

Once a student submits an assignment for grading, they are no longer eligible for a refund in the tuition-paid or supplemental programs.  

College Preparatory Academy:
Texas Tech K 12 offers both individual dual credit courses or a comprehensive Texas Tech College Preparatory Academy program. 

The College Preparatory Academy is designed to help students graduate with both a high school diploma and a bachelor's degree in just six years.

In order to apply for the College Preparatory Academy, you must meet the following criteria:
Mastered STAAR scores
One academic recommendation letter (upload file if available)
3.0 GPA

After selecting the program, you will be asked to enter your students’ information. 
With recent enhancements, Texas Tech K 12 is pleased to offer discounts for those who are connected to the Military and/or are a child of Texas Tech Employees. Please note that if you are Military, you will need to provide a copy of either your Military ID or DD Form 214. Children of Texas Tech Employees will need to provide a copy of the Parents Employee ID.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: How do I log into the Focus Portal?
faqs.answer:
After submitting the application, you should receive an email with your Focus Login information. Upon accessing the Focus Portal, enter your username and password which should take you to your Focus Dashboard.
If you have forgotten your password, please click "Forgot Password". Please enter your email address to receive your user credentials.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The dashboard is your starting point into managing your profile, accessing courses, reviewing the course catalog, utilizing forms and downloads, and contacting Texas Tech K 12.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the My Information tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Biographic information is displayed to you by clicking on "My Information" on the left-hand menu. 
The "My Information" displays contact information such as home address, business address, and other address with corresponding phone numbers and email addresses. 
Contacts or authorized users who can view your profile can be displayed here under "Linked Users,” or you may request an authorized user by clicking on the "New Contact" button and entering the required information.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Primary Information tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the Primary Information will display your name, your student id number and your username.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Accommodations tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the Accommodations will list any accommodations that the student has.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Address and Contacts tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Under the My Information tab, the Address & Contacts will allow you to view your current address. 
If your address or contacts have changed, you may update it via "New Address" and "New Contacts".

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Advisor tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Under the My Information tab, the Advisor tab will list the external school that was selected at the time of registration. 
If you have changed schools, you may select the new school. Once submitted, the information will be routed to Texas Tech K 12 staff for approval.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Demographics tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Under the My Information tab, the Demographics page will display your basic demographic information. This is for Full-Time Students Only.
From this page, you may update your external school, and your email address. Once submitted, the changes will be routed to Texas Tech K 12 staff for approval.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Documentation tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the documentation tab will allow you to access any documents that you have uploaded. If you need to upload updated documents, you will be able to do so through this screen.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Emergent Bilingual tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Under the My Information tab, the enrollment tab will display your current grade level as well as the enrollment code. This is for Full-Time Students Only.
You may also update your grade level from this page. Once submitted, the request will be routed to Texas Tech K 12 for approval.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the FitnessGram/PFAI tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the FitnessGram tab will allow you to enter in the required Fitness information. This is for Full-Time Students Only.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Graduation tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the Graduation tab will allow you to see the graduation plan for your student. This is for Full-Time Students Only.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the PEIMS tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the PEIMS tab will contain your students unique state id.

faqs.question: What is the Progress Report tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the Progress Report tab will show the current progress of each of the student's courses. Please note that the report is updated nightly.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Student Application Information tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the student application information tab will list basic information from your application.

faqs.question: What is the Student Schedule tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: Under the My Information tab, the student schedule tab will list your current enrollments along with start date (Enrolled), end date (Dropped) and your current enrollment status.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Communication tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The Communications tab will allow you to email your teacher and let you receive messages from Texas Tech K 12 staff.

faqs.question: What is the Change Requests tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The Change Requests tab will allow you to view your change requests. You may also "cancel" the request if the information was entered incorrectly.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Preferences tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
The preferences tab will allow you to update your display options, change your password and how you receive notifications.
Display Options will allow you to update how you view your student's information.
The Password tab will allow you to update your password. Please note that this will not change or update your student's password.
The Notifications tab will allow you to update your notifications. Texas Tech K 12 recommends that you set your notifications to "daily".

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What are the requirements for creating a new password?
faqs.answer:
The rules for creating a new password are:
passwords must be at least 12 characters long
must contain a mix of upper and lower-case characters
have at least 1 numeric character
have at least 1 special character
The password-change dialogue will display a warning message in red until the typed-in password meets all the requirements.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Class Schedule tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
Students can see what courses they are currently taking by clicking on the Class Schedule menu on the left side. 
If you would like to view additional details for each course, please select "class schedule" which will provide information on current courses and teacher information. 
Meeting Days, Room, Term, Attended Hours, and Print Reauthorization are not currently used by Texas Tech K 12 and can be ignored.

faqs.question: What is the Grades tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
The Grades tab will display the final course grade for all courses that have been taken with Texas Tech K 12. 
You will also have the option to print grade reports for each course. 
Grade reports are specific to each course and are not able to print all courses on one report.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Grade Requirements tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
The Grade Requirements will show how many credits you will need to complete your High School Diploma. 
Clicking on "Show Detailed" will show which classes have been used for the credits.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Focus Summary tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The Forms Summary will allow you to see any forms that have been submitted.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Purchase and Pay tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer:
The Purchase & Pay tab will allow you to purchase and pay for your enrollments with Texas Tech K 12. 
The catalog gives the parent the ability to search via the subject for the course or CBE.  Please note that students apart of the Texas Tech K 12 Tuition Free program will not have access to Purchase & Pay. 
Students, please note upon completion of the Purchase & Pay, it may take up to two business days for your course to populate.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: How do I purchase a course in Focus?
faqs.answer:
The Purchase and Pay tab will allow you to purchase and pay for your enrollments with Texas Tech K 12. Once you have found the course that you are enrolling in, please select "Add to Cart". The course will show "Added to Cart" while the course will appear on the right-hand side.
Once all courses have been selected, please press "Checkout" which will take you to the Checkout process to complete course payment. 
After pressing "Checkout", you should receive notification that you are being directed to Touchnet to complete payment information.
Upon entering payment information, you should receive payment confirmation.
Clicking on continue, you should receive your receipt as well as the option to print it out.

faqs.category: Student Portal and Account Setup - Focus Portal
faqs.question: What is the Customer Ledger tab in the Focus Dashboard?
faqs.answer: The Customer Ledger tab will allow you to print out a copy of a Focus receipt. You may also select "Show Details" under "Invoice Details" for more detailed information about the purchase.

faqs.question: Where can I find my Tech ID number?
faqs.answer: Your tech ID is shown in the Primary Information section of the "My Information" page in the Focus Portal.

faqs.question: I enrolled in the wrong course. Is there an option to transfer to another course?
faqs.answer: Students that have selected the wrong course are eligible to transfer to another course within the first 30 days of enrollment. To transfer to another course, we ask that you please submit the Student Course Drop/Transfer Refund Request form.

faqs.question: What is the Texas Tech K 12 course refund policy?
faqs.answer:
Partial refund requests are granted within the first 30 days of enrollment. No refunds will be granted after the first 30 days of enrollment. All requests for withdrawals should be submitted inside of Focus using the Course/Drop/Transfer Refund Request Form. Refunds are available for course fees only; credit by exams are nonrefundable.
There will be a $40.00 administration fee to process the withdrawal request.
Please note that the following items are non-refundable:
Admission fee
Shipping fees
CBEs
Exam retake fee
Print surcharge fee
Proctor change fee
Diploma replacement fee
Transcript request fee
Material Replacement fee
Withdrawal fee
Returned check fee

faqs.question: How do I get a refund for my textbook?
faqs.answer:
If you have purchased your textbooks from M B S Direct, we ask you please contact M B S Direct. In their help section, please look for "Returns & Refunds". 
If you do not qualify for a refund, you may be eligible to Sell Your Textbooks which will allow you to view the "current buy back price".

faqs.question: I would like to request a withdrawal refund; how do I do this?
faqs.answer:
Students that would like to request a refund, should login to their Focus portal. Underneath the "Forms" tab, please select the "Student Course Drop/Transfer Refund Request" form. 
After selecting the form, you should see your information and an option to select the course. Once you have filled out the information, please select the "Submit Request" button for processing. The form will be routed to the Finance team for review and processing.

faqs.question: What is the Supplemental Part-time program option?
faqs.answer:
Anyone looking to supplement their current school curriculum or home school curriculum can enroll in Texas Tech K 12. Our Texas Tech K 12 Supplemental Program is designed to allow students in elementary, middle and high school that allows students to work at their own pace. faqs.question: I have a complaint, who do I contact?
faqs.answer:
TTU K 12 encourages students and parents to discuss their concerns with the appropriate teacher, principal, or other campus administrator who has the authority to address their concerns. A concern at the informal level is an email or letter in hardcopy, addressed to the corresponding teacher, principal, or appropriate administrator. A student or parent may initiate the formal process by submitting the Parent Grievance or Grade Appeal Form inside of Focus within the prescribed time period of 30 days from the date that a decision or action gave rise to the complaint or grievance.

faqs.question: I want to submit a grade appeal; how do I do this?
faqs.answer:
Grievance forms may be filed inside of Focus, by hand delivery, or by U.S. mail. Hand-delivered filings shall be filed timely if received by the appropriate administrator or designee by the close of business on the deadline. Filings submitted by electronic communication shall be timely filed if they are received by the close of business on the deadline, as indicated by the date and time shown on the electronic communication. Level One electronic filings need to include the appropriate email address for the administrator who corresponds with the area of concern. Mail filings shall be timely filed if they are postmarked by U.S. mail on or before the deadline and received by the appropriate administrator or designated representative no more than three days after the deadline.

faqs.question: What are the attendance requirements for students in the Texas Tech K 12 Tuition-Free Program?
faqs.answer:
Note: If a caller requests to speak with a representative or a live person or someone else, please reiterate that it is currently after hours meaning we do not have any live agents at this time. In your all-online program, “attendance” will be defined as progress within each semester course. You will have six months (180 days from the date of enrollment) to complete each semester course. You must maintain enrollment in a minimum of four semester courses. You must complete a minimum of 5% of course assignments in every seven-day period. For example, if your course has 20 assignments, you need to complete a minimum of one per week. If your course has 60 assignments, you must average a minimum of three per week. Please note: Completing the minimum number of assignments does not guarantee you will complete within the 6-month time frame. Completing the minimum number of assignments and courses may not maintain your appropriate grade level or anticipated graduation date. If your progress is adequate, your parent may request “vacation” days. These must be requested and approved in advance.
Extensions are not available, so you must schedule your weekly progress to complete the minimum of four courses during the 6-month period.
Failure to meet minimum progress requirements may cause Texas Tech K 12 to implement truancy processes and may result in your removal from the program.
More information about Tuition-Free Program Policies can be found in our Attendance and Truancy policy.

All work submitted in this course must be your own. You may not use artificial intelligence tools to complete your assignments in this course. If an instructor suspects that an assignment is not the work of the student, it will receive a score of zero. The instructor will message the student or provide feedback on the assignment indicating the need to schedule a one-on-one video conference, during which the student will be required to demonstrate their skills or knowledge through an alternative or mutually agreed-upon assignment. The grade of the alternate or agreed upon assignment will be determined at the instructor’s discretion with the highest possible score being 70%. The incident will be reported to Texas Tech K 12 Administration and documented in the student’s file. Continued violations of Texas Tech University’s Academic Integrity Policy will result in the removal of the student from the program.
